Khushal Salon — Eid Ul Adha Campaign Strategy
Meta Ads · Eid Ul Adha Campaign

Khushal Salon
WhatsApp Lead Strategy

Bahria Phase 4, Rawalpindi · Maximum Bookings Campaign
Campaign Overview
Objective · Structure · Targeting · Why WhatsApp Messages
💬 Campaign Objective: MESSAGES (WhatsApp)
Why Messages? Fastest path to booking. User clicks → opens WhatsApp → you close the sale in chat. No landing page friction.
Campaign Type 1 Campaign → 3 Ad Sets → 2 Ads per Ad Set (6 total ads)
Platform Facebook + Instagram (automatic placements — let Meta optimize)
Duration 7–10 days before Eid ul Adha (start immediately, end day before Eid)
Daily Budget Minimum PKR 600–800/day per Ad Set (total PKR 1,800–2,400/day)
CTA Button "Send WhatsApp Message" — direct open to pre-filled message
Target Audience
3 km
Radius from Bahria Phase 4
20–45
Age Range (Women)
100%
Female Targeting
Location Pin 92, Civic Center, Bahria Town Phase 4, Rawalpindi — drop pin + 3km radius
Also Include Bahria Phase 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8 (overlap radius will auto-cover)
Gender Women only
Interests Hair salon, Beauty salon, Hair care, Personal grooming, Keratin treatment, Fashion, Eid shopping
Behaviors Engaged shoppers, Facebook page admins (business owners), Online buyers
Language Urdu + English (both)
Detailed Targeting Expansion OFF — keep it tight to Bahria area
Why This Structure Wins
  • One campaign = Meta optimizes budget across all 3 ad sets based on performance
  • Messages objective = pre-filled WhatsApp opens instantly — zero friction for customer
  • 3 ad sets = you know which service (hair treatment / haircut / root touching) converts most
  • Bahria Phase 4 pin = you're only paying for people who can actually visit the salon
  • Eid urgency = built-in FOMO + limited slots = people book now, not later
  • WhatsApp automation = no lead dies while you're busy — every message gets instant reply
Ad Sets + Budget Setup
3 Ad Sets targeting different service offers — each independently trackable
Ad Set 01
Chemical Treatments
Highlight: Hair Transformation 17,500 PKR
Also includes: Balayage, Keratin, Full Dye, Highlights, Baby Lights
Angle: Premium transformation at half price
Budget: PKR 800/day
Images: Use Image 1 (before/after)
HIGHEST VALUE
Ad Set 02
Haircut Services
Highlight: Signature Haircut 2,500 PKR
Also includes: Hair Artist 1,750 PKR
Angle: Low price = high volume bookings
Budget: PKR 600/day
Images: Use Image 2 (scissors/haircut)
HIGH VOLUME
Ad Set 03
Root Touching
Highlight: Root Touching 2,250 PKR
Angle: Quick, affordable Eid refresh
Budget: PKR 700/day
Images: Use Image 3 (root touching)
Target: Women who dye hair regularly
REPEAT CLIENTS
Budget & Schedule Breakdown
Ad Set Daily Budget 10-Day Total Expected Messages Est. Bookings
Chemical Treatments 800 PKR 8,000 PKR 15–25/day 40–60
Haircut Services 600 PKR 6,000 PKR 20–35/day 50–80
Root Touching 700 PKR 7,000 PKR 18–30/day 45–70
TOTAL 2,100 PKR 21,000 PKR 53–90/day 135–210
Ad Set Settings (Apply to All 3)
Optimization forConversations (not clicks)
BiddingLowest Cost (let Meta optimize first 3 days)
ScheduleAll day, but set ad schedule 9am–11pm (peak hours)
PlacementsAutomatic (Facebook Feed + Instagram Feed + Stories + Reels)
DestinationWhatsApp — pre-filled message (see WhatsApp tab)
PixelInstall Meta Pixel on any landing page if possible — not required for Messages campaign
Ad Copy — All 3 Offers
2 variants per offer — test both, pause the weaker one after Day 3
Offer 1 — Chemical Treatments (50% OFF)
Variant A — Emotional Hook
Primary Text
Eid aane wala hai — aur aap ka hair ab bhi wahi puraana look mein hai? 😕

Is Eid ul Adha, Khushal Salon de raha hai 50% OFF tamam chemical treatments par.

✅ Hair Transformation sirf 17,500 PKR (was 35,000)
✅ Balayage sirf 12,500 PKR
✅ Keratin Treatment 7,500 PKR
✅ Full Dye sirf 4,000 PKR

Expert stylists. Premium products. Luxury experience — Bahria Town mein.

⚠️ Limited slots available. Eid se pehle booking zaroor karein.
Headline
50% Off Hair Treatments — Eid Ul Adha Special
Description
Premium salon in Bahria Town. Book your Eid transformation today!
CTA Button
Send WhatsApp Message
Variant B — Price Shock Hook
Primary Text
35,000 ka Hair Transformation — ab sirf 17,500 PKR ✨

Khushal Salon ka Eid ul Adha offer — sirf limited time ke liye.

🎯 Before/After results dekh kar khud decide karein
💎 Bahria Town ka #1 luxury salon
⏰ Eid se pehle slots tezi se bhar rahe hain

Abhi message karein — free consultation bhi milega.
Headline
Hair Transformation at Half Price — Khushal Salon
Description
Eid ready look guaranteed. Expert stylists. Book now in Bahria Town.
CTA Button
Send WhatsApp Message
Offer 2 — Haircut Services (50% OFF)
Variant A — Direct Price
Primary Text
Eid mubarak wali tayyari shuru karo — fresh haircut ke saath! ✂️

Is Eid ul Adha, Khushal Salon mein haircut sirf:

✂️ Signature Haircut — 2,500 PKR (was 5,000)
✂️ Hair Artist Cut — 1,750 PKR (was 3,500)

Expert stylists • Hygienic environment • Bahria Town

Abhi WhatsApp par book karein — slots limited hain.
Headline
Eid Haircut — 50% Off at Khushal Salon
Description
Fresh look for Eid. Book now at 92 Civic Center, Bahria Town.
CTA Button
Send WhatsApp Message
Variant B — Urgency Hook
Primary Text
Eid par naya look chahiye? Abhi time hai! 🌙

Khushal Salon, Bahria Town — is Eid HALF PRICE haircut offer:
👑 Signature Cut sirf 2,500 PKR
👑 Hair Artist sirf 1,750 PKR

Professional stylists. Luxury feel. Affordable price.

💬 WhatsApp karein aur apna slot confirm karein.
Headline
Celebrate Eid with a Fresh New Look — Book Now
Description
Half price haircut this Eid. Limited slots at Khushal Salon, Bahria Town.
CTA Button
Send WhatsApp Message
Offer 3 — Root Touching (50% OFF)
Variant A — Problem/Solution
Primary Text
Eid ke kapre tayaar hain — lekin roots? 😬

Root Touching sirf 2,250 PKR — 50% off this Eid ul Adha.

✅ Professional colorists
✅ Quality products only
✅ Quick appointment — 1–2 hours
✅ Located in Bahria Town, Civic Center

Choti si investment — badi wali transformation.
WhatsApp karein aur Eid se pehle apna appointment pakka karein.
Headline
Root Touching — Rs.2,250 Only | Eid Offer
Description
50% off root touching this Eid. Expert care at Khushal Salon, Bahria Town.
CTA Button
Send WhatsApp Message
Variant B — Value Focus
Primary Text
4,500 PKR ka Root Touching — ab sirf 2,250 PKR 💛

Eid ul Adha mubarak! Khushal Salon mein is Eid special offer ke saath apne roots ko refresh karein.

📍 Bahria Town Civic Center, Rawalpindi
📅 Limited Eid slots available
⭐ Premium quality products

Abhi WhatsApp karein — free consultation + booking confirmation.
Headline
Eid Mubarak — Root Touching at Half Price!
Description
Refresh your look before Eid. Book your root touching at Khushal Salon.
CTA Button
Send WhatsApp Message
WhatsApp Auto-Greetings
Pre-filled message from ad + instant greeting when they open WhatsApp

Offer 2 (Haircut) Hi, I saw your Eid Haircut 50% off offer. I want to book an appointment.
Offer 3 (Root) Hi, I saw your Root Touching Eid offer at Rs.2,250. I want to book.
Instant Auto-Reply Greeting (WhatsApp Business App)

Bahria Town · Typically replies instantly

Just now ✓✓

Welcome to Khushal Salon, Bahria Town 💎

Kripya yeh batayein:

Just now
Full Auto-Reply Message Text
Set as "Away Message" + "Greeting Message" in WhatsApp Business
✨ *Eid Mubarak!* 🌙

Welcome to *Khushal Salon* — Bahria Town, Rawalpindi 💎

Shukriya hamare Eid ul Adha special offer mein interest lene ka! Aap bilkul sahi jagah aayi hain.

Hum aapki help karne ke liye available hain. Please yeh 3 cheezein bataein:

1️⃣ Kaunsi service chahiye? (Hair Treatment / Haircut / Root Touching)
2️⃣ Preferred date aur time kya hai?
3️⃣ Aapka naam kya hai?

Hum abhi aapka slot confirm kar denge! ⏰

📍 92, Civic Center, Bahria Town Phase 4
📞 03197886708 | 03325000040
Quick-Reply Buttons Setup (WhatsApp Business)
  • Button 1: "Book Appointment 📅"
  • Button 2: "Check Price List 💰"
  • Button 3: "Our Location 📍"
  • Button 4: "Call Us Now 📞"
FAQ — Automated Answers
Save these as Quick Replies in WhatsApp Business — reply in 1 tap
Q: Offer kab tak valid hai? (When does the offer expire?) ▾
WhatsApp Quick Reply — Save as "offer validity" Yeh special Eid ul Adha offer sirf *limited time* ke liye hai — Eid se pehle tak. ⏰

Slots tezi se bhar rahe hain, isliye aaj hi book karein taake aapka preferred time available ho.

Aapka appointment confirm karein? Apna preferred date batayein 📅
Q: Price list kya hai? / Konsi services discount mein hain? ▾
WhatsApp Quick Reply — Save as "price list" Yeh hai humara *Eid ul Adha 50% Off* price list 💛

✂️ *HAIRCUT:*
• Signature Cut — 2,500 PKR
• Hair Artist — 1,750 PKR

🎨 *CHEMICAL TREATMENTS:*
• Full Dye — 4,000 PKR
• Root Touching — 2,250 PKR
• Keratin — 7,500 PKR
• Balayage — 12,500 PKR
• Hair Transformation — 17,500 PKR
• Baby Lights — 10,000 PKR
• Highlights — 6,000 PKR
• Ombre/Sombre — 5,000 PKR

Kaunsi service book karni hai? 😊
Q: Location kahan hai? Address kya hai? ▾
WhatsApp Quick Reply — Save as "location" Hum yahan hain 📍

*Khushal Salon*
92, Civic Center
Bahria Town Phase 4, Rawalpindi

Google Maps pe "Khushal Salon Bahria Town" search karein — easily mil jaenge.

Parking available hai. Aapko koi aur guide chahiye? 😊
Q: Appointment kaise book karein? Walk-in bhi ho sakta hai? ▾
WhatsApp Quick Reply — Save as "booking" Booking WhatsApp ya call pe confirm hoti hai 📅

Walk-in bhi welcome hai, lekin *Eid ke time slots limited hain* — isliye advance booking better hai taake aapka preferred time available ho.

Abhi batayein:
✅ Kaunsi service?
✅ Kaunsa din aur time?
✅ Aapka naam?

Hum abhi confirm kar denge! 🙌
Q: Kitna time lagta hai? (How long does it take?) ▾
WhatsApp Quick Reply — Save as "duration" Service ke hisaab se time differ karta hai ⏱️

✂️ Haircut — 30–45 minutes
🎨 Root Touching — 1–1.5 hours
💎 Keratin — 2–3 hours
✨ Balayage/Baby Lights — 2–4 hours
👑 Hair Transformation — 3–5 hours

Appointment ke time pe aap relaxed aayein — hum aapka pura khayal rakhenge 💛

Booking karni hai? Date batayein!
Q: Konse products use hote hain? Safe hain? (Product safety) ▾
WhatsApp Quick Reply — Save as "products" Bilkul safe hain 💯

Hum sirf *premium international brands* use karte hain — jo specifically hair health ke liye formulated hain. Harsh chemicals se door rehte hain.

Hamari stylists trained hain aur aapke baalon ki condition ke hisaab se best product recommend karengi.

Pehle free consultation bhi available hai — bina kisi obligation ke. Interested hain?
Q: Booking cancel ya reschedule ho sakti hai? ▾
WhatsApp Quick Reply — Save as "cancellation" Ji haan, reschedule ho sakti hai 😊

Bas *24 ghante pehle* WhatsApp pe bata dein — hum dusra slot arrange kar denge.

Note: *Eid ke time slots bahut limited hain* — isliye please pehle se confirm karein taake kisi aur ko bhi moqa mile.

Koi aur sawaal? Hum yahan hain! 🙏
Q: Payment kaise hogi? Cash / Card / Online? ▾
WhatsApp Quick Reply — Save as "payment" Payment options available hain 💳

✅ Cash
✅ Easypaisa / JazzCash
✅ Bank Transfer

Advance payment zaruri nahi — booking pe confirm karna kaafi hai.

Ready to book? Apna preferred date batayein 📅
Follow-Up Message Sequence
For leads who messaged but didn't confirm booking — 5-message nurture sequence
1
Day 0 — Immediately after first contact (if no reply in 1 hour)
Instant Reminder — Slot Availability
Assalam o Alaikum! 🌙

Aapne Khushal Salon ke Eid offer mein interest show kiya tha — shukriya!

Hum aapka slot *abhi* confirm kar sakte hain. Sirf yeh batayein:

✅ Kaunsi service? (Haircut / Root Touching / Chemical Treatment)
✅ Preferred date?

Eid ke slots tezi se bhar rahe hain 🙏
2
Day 1 — 24 hours later (if no booking confirmed)
Social Proof + Urgency
Hi! 👋 Khushal Salon yahan se.

Aaj humne *[X] slots already book* ho gaye hain is Eid offer mein — aur bahut kam bache hain.

Aapki preferred date kaun si hai? Hum usse *hold* kar denge aapke liye — sirf aapka naam chahiye.

Jawab dein taake aapka spot pakka ho jaye ⏰
3
Day 3 — 3 days after initial contact
Before/After + Discount Reminder
Aap abhi tak book nahi kiya? 😊

Hum samajhte hain busy schedule hota hai — isliye hum flexible hain.

Yaad dilayein: Is Eid, *50% OFF* valid hai tamam services par:
💎 Hair Transformation: 17,500 PKR
✂️ Signature Haircut: 2,500 PKR
🎨 Root Touching: 2,250 PKR

Eid kaafi nazdik hai — last few slots bache hain. Confirm karein? 📅
4
Day 5 — 2 days before Eid (Final Push)
Last Chance Urgency Message
⚠️ LAST CHANCE — Eid se sirf 2 din baad hai!

Khushal Salon mein *sirf 3–4 slots bache hain* is Eid special 50% off ke liye.

Agar aap Eid par fresh, confident look chahti hain — abhi is waqt reply karein.

Kal subah ye slots gone ho sakte hain. Aapka Eid ready look pakka karein? 🌙✨
5
Post-Eid (3 days after Eid) — Re-engagement
Retention Message — Next Visit Offer
Eid Mubarak! 🌙 Hope you had a wonderful Eid!

Khushal Salon ki taraf se aapke liye ek special gift — aapki *next visit par 20% off*.

Simply yeh message show karein jab aap aaein.

Koi upcoming occasion hai? Birthday, walima, mehndi? Hum ready hain! 💛

📍 Bahria Town, Civic Center | 03197886708
No-Booking Reason Follow-Up
If lead says "baad mein" or goes quiet — send this
Koi baat nahi! 😊 Jab bhi ready hain, hum yahan hain.

Waise kya hum jaanen — kya koi cheez hai jo aapko hesitate kara rahi hai? Price, time, ya koi aur concern?

Hum aapke liye koi bhi arrangement kar sakte hain — flexible timing, group bookings (family ke saath), ya koi specific service combo.

Just let us know 🙏
Campaign Launch Checklist
Complete in order before going live
⚙️
Meta Ads Manager Setup
Do this before creating campaigns
  • WhatsApp Business number linked to Meta Business Suite
  • Facebook Page + Instagram connected to same Business Account
  • Payment method added (Visa/Mastercard or Meta coupon)
  • Campaign objective set to "Messages" (NOT traffic, NOT engagement)
  • WhatsApp selected as destination (not Messenger)
  • Creative images uploaded: Image 1, 2, 3 from Khushal Salon
  • Pre-filled message set for each ad set (see Tab 4)
📱
WhatsApp Business Setup
Before the first lead arrives
  • WhatsApp Business app downloaded + profile complete
  • Greeting message set (see Tab 4 full message)
  • Away message set for late-night hours
  • All 8 FAQ Quick Replies saved (see Tab 5)
  • Business hours set in WhatsApp Business profile
  • Catalog added (optional but recommended)
  • Label system: New Lead / Interested / Booked / Done
🎯
Targeting Verification
Double-check before publishing
  • Location: Bahria Town Phase 4, Rawalpindi — pin dropped correctly
  • Radius: 3–5 km from salon address
  • Gender: Women only selected
  • Age: 20–45 set
  • Detailed targeting expansion: OFF
  • Placements: Automatic (recommended)
  • Preview audience size: 15,000–50,000 (ideal range)
📊
Daily Management (During Campaign)
Check every morning
  • Check cost per message — should be under PKR 50–80
  • Pause underperforming variant (lower CTR after Day 3)
  • Increase budget on best-performing ad set by 20%
  • Reply to all WhatsApp messages within 1 hour
  • Send Day 1 follow-ups to all unconfirmed leads
  • Update slots availability messaging as Eid approaches
  • Screenshot best performing ad for future use
Key Metrics to Track
MetricTarget (Good)Action if Below Target
Cost Per Message (CPM)PKR 40–80 per messageChange ad creative or broaden audience slightly
Click-Through Rate (CTR)2%+ on feed adsTest new headline or change hook sentence
Message to Booking Rate30–50% (with automation)Improve FAQ responses / offer incentive
Cost Per BookingPKR 200–500Increase follow-up speed — reply faster
Daily Messages Received15–30/day minIncrease daily budget by PKR 200–300
Final Note — What Wins This Campaign
  • Speed kills. Reply to every WhatsApp message within 15 minutes — you will convert 3x more than competitors who take hours.
  • Urgency converts. Always mention "limited slots" and "Eid se pehle" in every reply — it's real and it works.
  • Follow up 5 times. Most bookings happen on the 3rd–4th message — don't give up after 1 try.
  • Label your leads. Use WhatsApp Business labels so no lead gets forgotten — every conversation has value.
  • Post-Eid is gold. Retain every client. The 20% off re-engagement message (Day 5) turns a seasonal client into a lifetime client.

            <ul class="journey-points">

      </section>

      <section class="section">

          <span class="eyebrow">Who This Is For</span>
          <h2 class="section-title">Built for business owners who want clarity before they scale or spend more.</h2>
        </div>

        <div class="audience-grid">
          <article class="audience-card reveal"><span class="audience-tag">Returns</span><h3>Businesses already spending on marketing</h3><p>If money is going out but qualified leads are not coming in, this session helps identify where the leak is.</p></article>
          <article class="audience-card reveal"><span class="audience-tag">Launch</span><h3>New businesses entering the market</h3><p>Start with the right system from day one instead of wasting months on channels that do not fit your offer.</p></article>

          <article class="audience-card reveal"><span class="audience-tag">Clarity</span><h3>Owners burned by agencies before</h3><p>Get objective direction first so your next marketing investment is made with confidence and full visibility.</p></article>

        <div class="visual-band">
          <article class="journey-card reveal">
            <span class="eyebrow">What You Leave With</span>

            <ul class="journey-points">

          </article>

          <article class="visual-panel reveal">
            <div class="visual-image">

            </div>
            <div class="visual-copy">
              <span class="micro-label">Clarity for founders</span>
              <h3>Every recommendation ties back to revenue, lead quality, or growth capacity.</h3>
              <p>The goal is not to impress you with jargon. The goal is to make your next marketing decision more accurate and more profitable.</p>
            </div>
          </article>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="section">
        <div class="reveal">
          <span class="eyebrow">Visual Strategy Layer</span>
          <h2 class="section-title">More than a conversation. A sharper way to see your growth system.</h2>
        </div>

        <div class="media-grid">
          <article class="media-card reveal">
            <div class="media-visual">

                <source src="https://player.vimeo.com/external/371433846.sd.mp4?s=236d1361fb2d99e0d4fd4efbed5f2adc18e3e1f9&profile_id=139&oauth2_token_id=57447761" type="video/mp4" />
              </video>
            </div>
            <div class="media-copy">
              <span class="micro-label">Founder View</span>

                <div class="media-stat"><strong>Audit</strong><span>Current channels, offers, and weak links</span></div>
                <div class="media-stat"><strong>Map</strong><span>Highest-ROI actions to prioritize first</span></div>
                <div class="media-stat"><strong>Build</strong><span>A system that fits your market reality</span></div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </article>

          <article class="media-card reveal">
            <div class="media-visual">
              <img decoding="async" src="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1520607162513-77705c0f0d4a?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=80" alt="Planning table with documents and laptop" />
            </div>
            <div class="media-copy">
              <span class="micro-label">Decision Support</span>
              <h3>Ideal for businesses that want clarity before committing bigger budgets.</h3>
              <p>Whether you are about to hire an agency, scale your Meta ads, rebuild your funnel, or fix your local visibility, this session gives you a more reliable starting point.</p>
            </div>
          </article>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="section" id="options">

        <div class="options-grid">

            <span class="option-tag">Free</span>

          <article class="option-card reveal">

            <ul class="feature-list">

      <section class="section">

              </div>
            </div>
          </article>

          <article class="faq-item reveal">
            <button class="faq-question" type="button">
              <div>
                <span>Can the consultation be done via WhatsApp or Zoom?</span>
                <small class="faq-tag">Format</small>
              </div>
              <span class="faq-icon">+</span>
            </button>
            <div class="faq-answer-wrap">
              <div class="faq-answer-inner">
                <p class="faq-answer">Yes. We conduct consultations via WhatsApp video call, Zoom, or Google Meet. In-person sessions at our office in Bahria Town, Rawalpindi are also available by appointment.</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </article>

          <article class="faq-item reveal">
            <button class="faq-question" type="button">
              <div>
                <span>Will I get anything actionable after the paid session?</span>
                <small class="faq-tag">Deliverable</small>
              </div>
              <span class="faq-icon">+</span>

              <div class="faq-answer-inner">
                <p class="faq-answer">Yes. The paid strategy session includes a documented action plan delivered within 48 hours, so you leave with a practical next-step roadmap.</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </article>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="section">
        <div class="cta-card reveal" id="cta">
          <div class="cta-copy">
            <span class="eyebrow">Ready for Clarity?</span>
            <h2>Stop collecting advice. Start building a marketing system that can actually scale.</h2>
            <p>If your business needs clearer priorities, a sharper plan, and a realistic growth roadmap, this consultation is the right place to start.</p>
            <div class="btn-row">
              <a class="btn btn-primary" href="https://wa.me/923135147935" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Book Your Consultation</a>
              <a class="btn btn-secondary" href="#top">Back to Top</a>
            </div>

            <div class="cta-mini">Useful whether you want a quick discovery call or a deeper strategic roadmap you can execute.</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
    </main>
  </div>

  <script>
    const reveals = document.querySelectorAll(".reveal");
    const faqItems = document.querySelectorAll(".faq-item");

    const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;
          entry.target.classList.add("visible");
          revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
        });
      },
      { threshold: 0.18 }
    );

    reveals.forEach((item) => revealObserver.observe(item));

    faqItems.forEach((item) => {
      const button = item.querySelector(".faq-question");
      button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const isActive = item.classList.contains("active");
        faqItems.forEach((entry) => entry.classList.remove("active"));
        if (!isActive) item.classList.add("active");
      });
    });
  </script>

            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="cta-stack">

            <div class="cta-mini">Built around audit, pillars, planning, production, publishing, and monthly review</div>

  <script>
    const reveals = document.querySelectorAll(".reveal");
    const tiltCards = document.querySelectorAll(".tilt-card");
    const faqItems = document.querySelectorAll(".faq-item");

    const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;
          entry.target.classList.add("visible");
          revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
        });
      },
      { threshold: 0.18 }
    );

    reveals.forEach((item) => revealObserver.observe(item));

    tiltCards.forEach((card) => {
      card.addEventListener("mousemove", (event) => {
        const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
        const x = event.clientX - rect.left;
        const y = event.clientY - rect.top;
        const rotateX = ((y / rect.height) - 0.5) * -8;
        const rotateY = ((x / rect.width) - 0.5) * 10;
        card.style.transform = `perspective(1200px) rotateX(${rotateX}deg) rotateY(${rotateY}deg) translateY(-6px)`;
      });

      card.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
        card.style.transform = "perspective(1200px) rotateX(0deg) rotateY(0deg) translateY(0)";
      });
    });

    faqItems.forEach((item) => {
      const button = item.querySelector(".faq-question");

      button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const isActive = item.classList.contains("active");

        faqItems.forEach((entry) => entry.classList.remove("active"));

        if (!isActive) item.classList.add("active");
      });
    });
  </script>

    const reveals = document.querySelectorAll(".reveal");
    const tiltCards = document.querySelectorAll(".tilt-card");
    const faqItems = document.querySelectorAll(".faq-item");

    const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;
          entry.target.classList.add("visible");
          revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
        });
      },
      { threshold: 0.18 }
    );

    reveals.forEach((item) => revealObserver.observe(item));

    tiltCards.forEach((card) => {
      card.addEventListener("mousemove", (event) => {
        const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
        const x = event.clientX - rect.left;
        const y = event.clientY - rect.top;
        const rotateX = ((y / rect.height) - 0.5) * -8;
        const rotateY = ((x / rect.width) - 0.5) * 10;
        card.style.transform = `perspective(1200px) rotateX(${rotateX}deg) rotateY(${rotateY}deg) translateY(-6px)`;
      });

      card.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
        card.style.transform = "perspective(1200px) rotateX(0deg) rotateY(0deg) translateY(0)";
      });
    });

    faqItems.forEach((item) => {

      button.addEventListener("click", () => {

        faqItems.forEach((entry) => entry.classList.remove("active"));

        if (!isActive) item.classList.add("active");
      });
    });

      --orange-glow: #fe6a09;
      --radius-xl: 38px;
      --radius-lg: 30px;
      --radius-md: 24px;
      --radius-sm: 18px;
      --shadow: 0 32px 90px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42);
      --max: 1280px;
    }

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    html {
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
    }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      font-family: "Inter", sans-serif;
      color: var(--white);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(254, 106, 9, 0.16), transparent 24%),
        radial-gradient(circle at top right, rgba(245, 71, 5, 0.12), transparent 24%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-1) 0%, var(--bg-2) 48%, var(--bg-1) 100%);
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    h1,
    h2,
    .section-title {
      font-family: "Orbitron", sans-serif;
    }

    h3,
    .package-card h3,
    .audience-card h3,
    .price-card h3,
    .brand-preview h3 {
      font-size: 30px;
      line-height: 1.24
      font-family: "Orbitron", sans-serif !important;
    }

    h2,
    .section-title,
    .philosophy-copy h2,
    .cta-copy h2 {
      font-size: 50px;
      line-height: 1.1;
      font-family: "Orbitron", sans-serif !important;
    }

    body::before,
    body::after {
      content: "";
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: -1;
    }

    body::before {
      background-image:
        linear-gradient(rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02) 1px, transparent 1px),
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02) 1px, transparent 1px);
      background-size: 88px 88px;
      mask-image: radial-gradient(circle at center, black 42%, transparent 100%);
      opacity: 0.74;
    }

    body::after {
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 14% 18%, rgba(253, 120, 22, 0.11), transparent 18%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 82% 14%, rgba(253, 120, 22, 0.08), transparent 16%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 76% 80%, rgba(255, 184, 117, 0.08), transparent 16%);
      animation: ambientFloat 18s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
    }

    img,
    iframe,
    svg {
      max-width: 100%;
      display: block;
    }

    a {
      color: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    .page-shell {
      width: min(calc(100% - 26px), 1400px);
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .section {
      width: min(100%, var(--max));
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 60px 0 20px;
      position: relative;
      margin-top:-60px;
     
    }

    .eyebrow {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.18em;
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--orange-soft);
    }

    .eyebrow::before {
      content: "";
      width: 38px;
      height: 1px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--orange-soft), transparent);
    }

    .section-title {
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      letter-spacing: 0;
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .section-copy,
    .hero-copy p,
    .premium-card p,
    .package-card p,
    .philosophy-copy p,
    .audience-card p,
    .price-card p,
    .faq-answer,
    .cta-copy p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--muted);
      line-height: 1.8;
      font-size: 1rem;
    }

    .glass {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03));
      border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .btn-row {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 14px;
      margin: 30px 0 24px;
    }

    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 15px 24px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--white);
      transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease;
    }

    .btn:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
    }

    .btn-primary {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--orange), var(--orange-deep));
      box-shadow: 0 18px 34px rgba(245, 71, 5, 0.24);
    }

    .btn-secondary {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
    }

    .hero {
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.94fr 1.06fr;
      gap: 34px;
      align-items: center;
      padding-top: 44px;
    }

    .hero-copy h1 {
      margin: 0;
      max-width: 15ch;
      font-size: clamp(42px, 6vw, 55px);
      
      font-family: "Orbitron", sans-serif !important;
      
      letter-spacing: 0;
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .hero-copy h1 span {
      color: var(--orange-glow);
      text-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(253, 120, 22, 0.22);
    }

    .hero-tags {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 0;
      margin: 0;
    }

    .hero-tags li {
      padding: 10px 15px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
      color: var(--white-soft);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
    }

    .hero-stage {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 760px;
      border-radius: 42px;
      padding: 22px;
      overflow: hidden;
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(8, 8, 8, 0.08), rgba(8, 8, 8, 0.9)),
        radial-gradient(circle at 20% 16%, rgba(254, 106, 9, 0.32), transparent 28%),
        url("https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1455390582262-044cdead277a?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1400&q=80") center/cover;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      isolation: isolate;
    }

    .hero-stage::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 0;
      background:
        linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(254, 106, 9, 0.1), transparent 34%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(5, 5, 5, 0.08), rgba(5, 5, 5, 0.94));
    }

    .hero-stage::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      right: -90px;
      top: 120px;
      width: 300px;
      height: 300px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(254, 106, 9, 0.22), transparent 68%);
      filter: blur(8px);
      z-index: 0;
    }

    .brand-interface {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      min-height: 716px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto;
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .brand-board,
    .palette-card,
    .logo-mark-card,
    .brand-preview,
    .brand-metric {
      border-radius: 28px;
      background: rgba(8, 8, 8, 0.62);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      box-shadow: 0 22px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28);
    }

    .brand-top {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 0.74fr;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .board-bar {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 15px 16px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    }

    .dot {
      width: 9px;
      height: 9px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28);
    }

    .dot:nth-child(1) {
      background: var(--orange);
    }

    .dot:nth-child(2) {
      background: #ffb875;
    }

    .dot:nth-child(3) {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.42);
    }

    .board-title {
      margin-left: 8px;
      min-width: 0;
      flex: 1;
      padding: 9px 12px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }

    .board-content,
    .palette-card,
    .logo-mark-card,
    .brand-preview,
    .brand-metric {
      padding: 20px;
    }

    .micro-label,
    .package-no,
    .audience-tag,
    .price-tag,
    .faq-tag {
      display: inline-block;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      color: var(--orange-soft);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .brand-system-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 0.72fr;
      gap: 14px;
      margin-top: 14px;
    }

    .brand-tile {
      min-height: 92px;
      border-radius: 18px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
    }

    .brand-tile.main {
      min-height: 198px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(254, 106, 9, 0.26), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)),
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
    }

    .brand-symbol {
      width: 108px;
      height: 108px;
      border-radius: 34px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--orange), var(--orange-deep));
      box-shadow: 0 26px 44px rgba(254, 106, 9, 0.24);
      font-family: "Orbitron", sans-serif;
      font-size: 3rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .brand-lines {
      display: grid;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .brand-line {
      height: 14px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.11);
    }

    .brand-line.orange {
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--orange), rgba(255, 184, 117, 0.38));
    }

    .brand-line.short {
      width: 66%;
    }

    .palette-card {
      display: grid;
      align-content: space-between;
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .palette-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .swatch {
      min-height: 74px;
      border-radius: 18px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    }

    .swatch.one {
      background: #fe6a09;
    }

    .swatch.two {
      background: #f54705;
    }

    .swatch.three {
      background: #fff6ef;
    }

    .swatch.four {
      background: #151515;
    }

    .font-sample {
      display: grid;
      gap: 9px;
    }

    .font-sample strong {
      display: block;
      font-family: "Orbitron", sans-serif;
      font-size: 1.35rem;
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .font-sample span {
      color: var(--muted);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    .brand-middle {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.82fr 1.18fr;
      gap: 16px;
      align-items: stretch;
    }

    .logo-mark-card {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      min-height: 320px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at center, rgba(254, 106, 9, 0.18), transparent 42%),
        rgba(8, 8, 8, 0.62);
    }

    .logo-lockup {
      width: min(100%, 220px);
      aspect-ratio: 1;
      border-radius: 42px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      background:
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(254, 106, 9, 0.22), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)),
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .logo-lockup::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 150%;
      height: 32px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
      transform: rotate(-32deg);
      animation: shineSweep 5s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .logo-lockup span {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      width: 112px;
      height: 112px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--orange), var(--orange-deep));
      font-family: "Orbitron", sans-serif;
      font-size: 3.2rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--white);
      box-shadow: 0 26px 44px rgba(254, 106, 9, 0.24);
    }

    .brand-preview {
      display: grid;
      align-content: space-between;
      gap: 18px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08), rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.72)),
        rgba(8, 8, 8, 0.64);
    }

    .preview-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      width: fit-content;
      padding: 8px 12px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(254, 106, 9, 0.14);
      border: 1px solid rgba(254, 106, 9, 0.28);
      color: #ffb875;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 0.78rem;
    }

    .brand-preview h3 {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .brand-preview p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--muted);
      line-height: 1.75;
    }

    .preview-actions {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .preview-action {
      padding: 10px 13px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09);
      color: var(--white-soft);
      font-size: 0.86rem;
    }

    .brand-metrics {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .brand-metric strong {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      font-family: "Orbitron", sans-serif;
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .brand-metric span {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    .premium-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.04fr 0.96fr;
      gap: 22px;
      align-items: stretch;
    }

    .premium-card,
    .premium-visual {
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .premium-card {
      padding: 38px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(254, 106, 9, 0.14), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04)),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02));
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    }

    .premium-grid {
      margin-top: 26px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .premium-mini {
      padding: 20px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: rgba(8, 8, 8, 0.38);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      color: var(--white-soft);
      transition: transform 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease;
    }

    .premium-mini:hover {
      transform: translateY(-8px);
      border-color: rgba(253, 120, 22, 0.32);
    }

    .premium-mini strong {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .premium-visual {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 100%;
      padding: 30px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(8, 8, 8, 0.14), rgba(8, 8, 8, 0.88)),
        url("https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1516321497487-e288fb19713f?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=80") center/cover;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
    }

    .premium-overlay {
      width: 100%;
      display: grid;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .tag-row {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .tag-pill {
      padding: 10px 14px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
      color: var(--white-soft);
      font-size: 0.86rem;
    }

    .package-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .package-card {
      min-height: 350px;
      padding: 24px;
      border-radius: 30px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08), rgba(14, 14, 14, 0.9)),
        var(--package-bg, linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(254, 106, 9, 0.16), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03)));
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      transition: transform 0.32s ease, box-shadow 0.32s ease, border-color 0.32s ease;
    }

    .package-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-10px);
      box-shadow: 0 24px 54px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
      border-color: rgba(253, 120, 22, 0.34);
    }

    .package-card::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 16px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .package-media {
      height: 150px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .package-media img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      transition: transform 0.5s ease;
    }

    .package-card:hover .package-media img {
      transform: scale(1.08);
    }

    .package-no {
      width: 54px;
      height: 54px;
      border-radius: 18px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(254, 106, 9, 0.24), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05));
      border: 1px solid rgba(253, 120, 22, 0.3);
    }

    .package-card h3,
    .philosophy-copy h2,
    .audience-card h3,
    .price-card h3,
    .faq-question span,
    .cta-copy h2 {
      display: block;
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .philosophy-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.94fr 1.06fr;
      gap: 24px;
      align-items: stretch;
    }

    .philosophy-copy,
    .philosophy-stage {
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .philosophy-copy {
      padding: 38px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(73, 73, 74, 0.24), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04)),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05), rgba(15, 15, 15, 0.88));
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    }

    .philosophy-copy h2 {
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .philosophy-points {
      margin-top: 26px;
      display: grid;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .philosophy-points article {
      padding: 18px 20px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: rgba(8, 8, 8, 0.4);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      color: var(--white-soft);
      transition: transform 0.3s ease;
    }

    .philosophy-points article:hover {
      transform: translateX(8px);
    }

    .philosophy-points strong {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .philosophy-stage {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 100%;
      padding: 28px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(8, 8, 8, 0.16), rgba(8, 8, 8, 0.9)),
        url("https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1504384308090-c894fdcc538d?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=80") center/cover;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
    }

    .philosophy-core {
      width: min(100%, 430px);
      padding: 22px;
      border-radius: 28px;
      background: rgba(8, 8, 8, 0.56);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    }

    .philosophy-core svg {
      width: 100%;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 18px 34px rgba(254, 106, 9, 0.18));
      animation: levitate 7s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .audience-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .audience-card {
      min-height: 250px;
      padding: 22px;
      border-radius: 26px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07), rgba(14, 14, 14, 0.9)),
        var(--audience-bg, linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(254, 106, 9, 0.14), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03)));
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      transition: transform 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease;
    }

    .audience-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-8px);
      border-color: rgba(253, 120, 22, 0.34);
    }

    .pricing-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .price-card {
      min-height: 330px;
      padding: 24px;
      border-radius: 30px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08), rgba(14, 14, 14, 0.92)),
        var(--price-bg, linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(254, 106, 9, 0.16), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03)));
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      transition: transform 0.32s ease, box-shadow 0.32s ease, border-color 0.32s ease;
    }

    .price-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-10px);
      box-shadow: 0 24px 54px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
      border-color: rgba(253, 120, 22, 0.34);
    }

    .price-card::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 16px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .price {
      margin: 8px 0 16px;
      font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3vw, 2.6rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.1;
      color: var(--orange-glow);
    }

    .price-list {
      list-style: none;
      margin: 18px 0 0;

              <a class="btn btn-secondary" href="#top">Back to Top</a>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="cta-stack">
            <div class="cta-mini">Logo design, color systems, typography, social kits, and brand guidelines</div>
            <div class="cta-mini">Premium, minimal, real-world-ready creative direction instead of generic visuals</div>

  <script>
    const reveals = document.querySelectorAll(".reveal");
    const tiltCards = document.querySelectorAll(".tilt-card");
    const faqItems = document.querySelectorAll(".faq-item");

    const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;

          entry.target.classList.add("visible");
          revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
        });
      },
      {
        threshold: 0.18
      }
    );

    reveals.forEach((item) => revealObserver.observe(item));

    tiltCards.forEach((card) => {
      card.addEventListener("mousemove", (event) => {
        const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
        const x = event.clientX - rect.left;
        const y = event.clientY - rect.top;
        const rotateX = ((y / rect.height) - 0.5) * -8;
        const rotateY = ((x / rect.width) - 0.5) * 10;

        card.style.transform = `perspective(1200px) rotateX(${rotateX}deg) rotateY(${rotateY}deg) translateY(-6px)`;
      });

      card.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
        card.style.transform = "perspective(1200px) rotateX(0deg) rotateY(0deg) translateY(0)";
      });
    });

    faqItems.forEach((item) => {
      const button = item.querySelector(".faq-question");

      button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const isActive = item.classList.contains("active");

        faqItems.forEach((entry) => entry.classList.remove("active"));

        if (!isActive) item.classList.add("active");
      });
    });
  </script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">

  />

    name="keywords"
    content="website development Rawalpindi, web design Pakistan, SEO website Islamabad, WordPress development Rawalpindi, conversion website Pakistan"
  />

  <style>
    @import url("https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&family=Orbitron:wght@600;700;800;900&display=swap");

    :root {
      --bg-1: #040404;
      --bg-2: #0b0b0b;
      --bg-3: #111111;
      --panel: rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.88);
      --panel-strong: rgba(22, 22, 22, 0.96);

    }

    }

      scroll-behavior: smooth;
    }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      font-family: "Inter", sans-serif;
      color: var(--white);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(254, 106, 9, 0.16), transparent 24%),
        radial-gradient(circle at top right, rgba(245, 71, 5, 0.12), transparent 24%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-1) 0%, var(--bg-2) 48%, var(--bg-1) 100%);

    }

    h2,
    h3,
    .section-title,

    .build-card h3,
    .include-card h3,

    body::before,

      content: "";

      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: -1;
    }

    body::before {
      background-image:

    img,

    .section {

    .eyebrow {

    const reveals = document.querySelectorAll(".reveal");
    const tiltCards = document.querySelectorAll(".tilt-card");
    const faqItems = document.querySelectorAll(".faq-item");

    const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;

          entry.target.classList.add("visible");
          revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
        });
      },
      {
        threshold: 0.18
      }
    );

    reveals.forEach((item) => revealObserver.observe(item));

    tiltCards.forEach((card) => {
      card.addEventListener("mousemove", (event) => {
        const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
        const x = event.clientX - rect.left;
        const y = event.clientY - rect.top;
        const rotateX = ((y / rect.height) - 0.5) * -8;
        const rotateY = ((x / rect.width) - 0.5) * 10;

        card.style.transform = `perspective(1200px) rotateX(${rotateX}deg) rotateY(${rotateY}deg) translateY(-6px)`;
      });

      card.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
        card.style.transform = "perspective(1200px) rotateX(0deg) rotateY(0deg) translateY(0)";
      });
    });

    faqItems.forEach((item) => {
      const button = item.querySelector(".faq-question");

      button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const isActive = item.classList.contains("active");

        faqItems.forEach((entry) => entry.classList.remove("active"));

        if (!isActive) item.classList.add("active");
      });
    });

    video {
      max-width: 100%;
      display: block;
    }

    a {
      color: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    .page-shell {
      width: min(calc(100% - 26px), 1400px);
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .section {
      width: min(100%, var(--max));
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 60px 0 20px;
      position: relative;
      margin-top:-60px;
    }

    .eyebrow {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.18em;
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--orange-soft);
    }

    .eyebrow::before {
      content: "";
      width: 38px;
      height: 1px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--orange-soft), transparent);
    }

    .section-title {
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 3.7vw, 4.25rem);
      line-height: 1.08;
      letter-spacing: 0;
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .section-copy,
    .hero-copy p,
    .capture-card p,
    .service-card p,
    .campaign-card p,
    .comparison-copy p,
    .faq-answer,
    .cta-copy p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--muted);
      line-height: 1.8;
      font-size: 1rem;
    }

    .glass {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03));
      border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .btn-row {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 14px;
      margin: 30px 0 24px;
    }

    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 15px 24px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--white);
      transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease;
    }

    .btn:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
    }

    .btn-primary {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--orange), var(--orange-deep));
      box-shadow: 0 18px 34px rgba(245, 71, 5, 0.24);
    }

    .btn-secondary {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
    }

    .hero {
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.92fr 1.08fr;
      gap: 34px;
      align-items: center;
      padding-top: 44px;
    }

    .hero-copy h1 {
      margin: 0;
      max-width: 15ch;
      font-size: clamp(42px, 6vw, 55px)!important;

      font-family: "Orbitron", sans-serif !important;     
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .hero-copy h1 span {
      color: #fe6a09;
      text-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(253, 120, 22, 0.22);
    }

    .hero-tags {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 0;
      margin: 0;
    }

    .hero-tags li {
      padding: 10px 15px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
      color: var(--white-soft);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
    }

    .hero-stage {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 760px;
      border-radius: 42px;
      padding: 22px;
      overflow: hidden;
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(8, 8, 8, 0.08), rgba(8, 8, 8, 0.88)),
        radial-gradient(circle at 25% 18%, rgba(254, 106, 9, 0.28), transparent 28%),
        url("https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1551434678-e076c223a692?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1400&q=80") center/cover;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      isolation: isolate;
    }

    .hero-stage::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(254, 106, 9, 0.08), transparent 36%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(5, 5, 5, 0.1), rgba(5, 5, 5, 0.92));
      z-index: 0;
    }

    .hero-dashboard {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      height: 100%;
      min-height: 716px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto;
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .dashboard-top {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 0.72fr;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .search-window,
    .budget-window,
    .ad-preview,
    .funnel-panel,
    .hero-kpi {
      border-radius: 28px;
      background: rgba(8, 8, 8, 0.62);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      box-shadow: 0 22px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28);
    }

    .window-bar {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 15px 16px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    }

    .dot {
      width: 9px;
      height: 9px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28);
    }

    .dot:nth-child(1) {
      background: var(--orange);
    }

    .dot:nth-child(2) {
      background: var(--orange-glow);
    }

    .dot:nth-child(3) {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.42);
    }

    .search-content,
    .budget-window,
    .ad-preview,
    .funnel-panel,
    .hero-kpi {
      padding: 20px;
    }

    .search-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 14px;
      border-radius: 18px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      color: var(--white-soft);
    }

    .search-icon {
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--orange), var(--orange-deep));
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .keyword-stack {
      display: grid;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-top: 18px;
    }

    .keyword-line {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
      gap: 12px;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 12px 14px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.045);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.92rem;
    }

    .keyword-line strong {
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
    }

    .budget-window {
      display: grid;
      align-content: space-between;
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .micro-label {
      display: inline-block;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      color: var(--orange-soft);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .budget-number {
      font-family: "Orbitron", sans-serif;
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.4rem);
      line-height: 1;
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .budget-meter {
      height: 12px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .budget-meter span {
      display: block;
      height: 100%;
      width: 76%;
      border-radius: inherit;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--orange-deep), var(--orange-glow));
      box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(254, 106, 9, 0.45);
    }

    .hero-middle {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.86fr 1.14fr;
      gap: 16px;
      align-items: stretch;
    }

    .funnel-panel {
      display: grid;
      align-content: center;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .funnel-step {
      position: relative;
      padding: 16px 18px;
      border-radius: 18px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      color: var(--white-soft);
    }

    .funnel-step strong {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 5px;
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .funnel-step::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      left: 18px;
      top: -17px;
      width: 2px;
      height: 17px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, var(--orange));
    }

    .funnel-step:first-of-type::before {
      display: none;
    }

    .ad-preview {
      display: grid;
      align-content: space-between;
      gap: 18px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08), rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.72)),
        rgba(8, 8, 8, 0.64);
    }

    .ad-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      width: fit-content;
      padding: 8px 12px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(254, 106, 9, 0.14);
      border: 1px solid rgba(254, 106, 9, 0.28);
      color: var(--orange-glow);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 0.78rem;
    }

    .ad-preview h3 {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 30px;
      line-height: 1.12;
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .ad-preview p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--muted);
      line-height: 1.75;
    }

    .ad-actions {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .ad-action {
      padding: 10px 13px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09);
      color: var(--white-soft);
      font-size: 0.86rem;
    }

    .hero-kpis {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .hero-kpi strong {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      font-family: "Orbitron", sans-serif;
      font-size: 1.55rem;
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .hero-kpi span {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    .pulse-ring {
      position: absolute;
      right: 42px;
      top: 52%;
      width: 170px;
      height: 170px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 1px solid rgba(254, 106, 9, 0.34);
      animation: pulseRing 3.8s ease-in-out infinite;
      z-index: 0;
    }

    .pulse-ring::before,
    .pulse-ring::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 22px;
      border-radius: inherit;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 179, 106, 0.24);
    }

    .pulse-ring::after {
      inset: 48px;
      background: rgba(254, 106, 9, 0.14);
      border-color: rgba(254, 106, 9, 0.34);
    }

    .capture-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.04fr 0.96fr;
      gap: 22px;
      align-items: stretch;
    }

    .capture-card,
    .capture-visual {
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .capture-card {
      padding: 38px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(254, 106, 9, 0.14), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04)),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02));
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    }

    .capture-grid {
      margin-top: 26px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .capture-mini {
      padding: 20px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: rgba(8, 8, 8, 0.38);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      color: var(--white-soft);
      transition: transform 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease;
    }

    .capture-mini:hover {
      transform: translateY(-8px);
      border-color: rgba(253, 120, 22, 0.32);
    }

    .capture-mini strong {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .capture-visual {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 100%;
      padding: 30px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(8, 8, 8, 0.14), rgba(8, 8, 8, 0.88)),
        url("https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1460925895917-afdab827c52f?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=80") center/cover;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
    }

    .capture-overlay {
      width: 100%;
      display: grid;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .tag-row {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .tag-pill {
      padding: 10px 14px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
      color: var(--white-soft);
      font-size: 0.86rem;
    }

    .services-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .service-card {
      min-height: 355px;
      padding: 24px;
      border-radius: 30px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08), rgba(14, 14, 14, 0.9)),
        var(--service-bg, linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(254, 106, 9, 0.16), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03)));
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      transition: transform 0.32s ease, box-shadow 0.32s ease, border-color 0.32s ease;
    }

    .service-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-10px);
      box-shadow: 0 24px 54px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
      border-color: rgba(253, 120, 22, 0.34);
    }

    .service-card::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 16px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .service-media {
      height: 150px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .service-media img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      transition: transform 0.5s ease;
    }

    .service-card:hover .service-media img {
      transform: scale(1.08);
    }

    .service-no,
    .campaign-chip,
    .faq-tag {
      display: inline-block;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      color: var(--orange-soft);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .service-no {
      width: 54px;
      height: 54px;
      border-radius: 18px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(254, 106, 9, 0.24), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05));
      border: 1px solid rgba(253, 120, 22, 0.3);
    }

    .service-card h3,
    .campaign-card h3,
    .faq-question span {
      display: block;
      color: var(--white);
      line-height: 1.4;
      font-size:20px!important;
    }
.cta-copy h2{font-size:30px!important;display: block;
      color: var(--white);
      line-height: 1.4;}
    .campaign-wrap {
      border-radius: 40px;
      padding: 36px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top right, rgba(254, 106, 9, 0.18), transparent 24%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06), rgba(12, 12, 12, 0.9));
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    }

    .campaign-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
      margin-top: 26px;
    }

    .campaign-card {
      min-height: 230px;
      padding: 22px;
      border-radius: 26px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07), rgba(14, 14, 14, 0.88));
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      transition: transform 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease;
    }

    .campaign-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-8px);
      border-color: rgba(253, 120, 22, 0.34);
    }

    .comparison-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.94fr 1.06fr;
      gap: 24px;
      align-items: stretch;
    }

    .comparison-copy,
    .comparison-stage {
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .comparison-copy {
      padding: 38px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(73, 73, 74, 0.24), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04)),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05), rgba(15, 15, 15, 0.88));
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    }

    .comparison-copy h2 {
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3.6vw, 3.4rem);
      line-height: 1.12;
    }

    .compare-points {
      margin-top: 26px;
      display: grid;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .compare-points article {
      padding: 18px 20px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: rgba(8, 8, 8, 0.4);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      color: var(--white-soft);
      transition: transform 0.3s ease;
    }

    .compare-points article:hover {
      transform: translateX(8px);
    }

    .compare-points strong {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .comparison-stage {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 100%;
      padding: 28px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(8, 8, 8, 0.16), rgba(8, 8, 8, 0.9)),
        url("https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1551434678-e076c223a692?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=80") center/cover;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
    }

    .comparison-core {
      width: min(100%, 430px);
      padding: 22px;
      border-radius: 28px;
      background: rgba(8, 8, 8, 0.56);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    }

    .comparison-core svg {
      width: 100%;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 18px 34px rgba(254, 106, 9, 0.18));
      animation: levitate 7s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .faq-grid {
      display: grid;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .faq-item {
      border-radius: 24px;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07), rgba(14, 14, 14, 0.9));
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      transition: border-color 0.28s ease, background 0.28s ease;
    }

    .faq-item.active {
      border-color: rgba(253, 120, 22, 0.3);
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08), rgba(18, 18, 18, 0.92));
    }

    .faq-question {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 22px 24px;
      border: 0;
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--white);
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 18px;
      cursor: pointer;
      text-align: left;
      font: inherit;
    }

    .faq-question span {
      font-size: 1.04rem;
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .faq-icon {
      width: 42px;
      height: 42px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      color: var(--orange-soft);
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      transition: transform 0.28s ease;
    }

    .faq-item.active .faq-icon {
      transform: rotate(45deg);
    }

    .faq-answer-wrap {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-rows: 0fr;
      transition: grid-template-rows 0.35s ease;
    }

    .faq-item.active .faq-answer-wrap {
      grid-template-rows: 1fr;
    }

    .faq-answer-inner {
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .faq-answer {
      padding: 0 24px 24px;
    }

    .cta-card {
      border-radius: 38px;
      padding: 38px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 0.95fr;
      gap: 24px;
      align-items: center;
      background:
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(254, 106, 9, 0.22), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06), rgba(12, 12, 12, 0.92));
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
      margin-bottom: 70px;
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
    }

    .cta-card::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      right: -80px;
      bottom: -90px;
      width: 270px;
      height: 270px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255, 179, 106, 0.24), transparent 68%);
      filter: blur(8px);
    }

    .cta-copy h2 {
      margin: 0 0 14px;
      font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3.6vw, 3.4rem);
      line-height: 1.1;
    }

    .cta-stack {
      display: grid;
      gap: 14px;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .cta-mini {
      padding: 18px 20px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.46);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      color: var(--white-soft);
    }

    .reveal {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(24px);
      transition: opacity 0.9s ease, transform 0.9s ease;
    }

    .reveal.visible {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    .tilt-card {
      transform-style: preserve-3d;
      transition: transform 0.2s ease-out;
    }

    @keyframes levitate {
      0%, 100% {
        transform: translateY(0);
      }

      50% {
        transform: translateY(-12px);
      }
    }

    @keyframes ambientFloat {
      0% {
        transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) scale(1);
      }

      100% {
        transform: translate3d(0, 18px, 0) scale(1.04);
      }
    }

    @keyframes pulseRing {
      0%, 100% {
        transform: translateY(-50%) scale(0.92);
        opacity: 0.48;
      }

      50% {
        transform: translateY(-50%) scale(1.08);
        opacity: 0.9;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 1180px) {
      .hero,

    const reveals = document.querySelectorAll(".reveal");
    const tiltCards = document.querySelectorAll(".tilt-card");
    const faqItems = document.querySelectorAll(".faq-item");

    const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;

          entry.target.classList.add("visible");
          revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
        });
      },
      {
        threshold: 0.18
      }
    );

    reveals.forEach((item) => revealObserver.observe(item));

    tiltCards.forEach((card) => {
      card.addEventListener("mousemove", (event) => {
        const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
        const x = event.clientX - rect.left;
        const y = event.clientY - rect.top;
        const rotateX = ((y / rect.height) - 0.5) * -8;
        const rotateY = ((x / rect.width) - 0.5) * 10;

        card.style.transform = `perspective(1200px) rotateX(${rotateX}deg) rotateY(${rotateY}deg) translateY(-6px)`;
      });

      card.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
        card.style.transform = "perspective(1200px) rotateX(0deg) rotateY(0deg) translateY(0)";
      });
    });

    faqItems.forEach((item) => {
      const button = item.querySelector(".faq-question");

        faqItems.forEach((entry) => entry.classList.remove("active"));

        if (!isActive) item.classList.add("active");
      });
    });
